scope: Connect task-manifest phone patch to existing five-stage controller and fixed isolated tests, preserving native diagnostics, cleanup and reporter integrity.
riskAnalysis: Source/auth/worker/test-evidence changes require STRICT. Model code limited to reviewed pure search-expression AST; no arbitrary execution or publication. Historical single-file profiles unchanged.

threatModel.abuseCases: Traversal/protected edits, reporter constructor escape, comments hiding adjacent source, forged tests/identity, stale grants, cleanup and diagnostic loss.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact server manifest/preimages, pinned parser/pure AST, old OS supervisor/23checks, fresh native permission, exact native evidence/rules, awaited cleanup and serial execution.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing Chief/Specialist/QA/Auditor/Chief, controller, journal, workers, reservations and OSsupervisor reused.

proactiveReview.threats: Reporter escape, broad capability reachability, forged source/review, scope omissions and stale authority.

proactiveReview.faultInjection: Native malformedworker, unsafeconstructor, cleanupfailure, authorityrevocation, stalebinding, ledgerrecognition and reportcodec checks.

proactiveReview.recovery: Revert candidate only; preserve original assets, failed attempts and accounting; fail closed on uncertain cleanup.
proactiveReview.readiness: Reviewed candidate only. Hosted STRICT/Redis/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser and actual isolated-profile execution remain required before claiming live success.
